description: Send a failed delivery again, now. It works only while its event is still kept (24 hours). A test delivery is never retried: call `test_webhook` again. The delivery's `retryable` says whether it can be retried. A workspace can send 60 deliveries again an hour. A signed-in owner can call this, or an API key with both setup and read permission. A key works only on a webhook a key saved: one a person saved answers 409 `webhookSavedByPerson`, so ask the owner with `create_handoff`, kind `manage_webhook`.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: retry_webhook_delivery
title: Retry a webhook delivery
